location: Approximate and precise location when selected
Driver locations during an online shift
financial_info: Ride/delivery transaction amounts, receipts and cash collection status; cards disabled for current launch
photos_and_other_content: Delivery recipient signature and proof fields, when supplied
app_activity: Bookings, job state changes, ratings and driver status
diagnostics_and_identifiers: Server request/security logs and IP addresses

third_party_processing_to_review: Configured browser push provider if enabled
Configured SMS provider for sign-in codes if enabled (receives phone number and code text)
encryption_in_transit: HTTPS required by release Android app; verify all deployed services and providers
account_deletion: In-app and external web flow (password or SMS code for phone-only accounts) plus verified email request; active jobs/settlements require resolution; limited transaction/security records retained

foreground_service.start: Driver explicitly chooses Go online with location permission from visible driver screen
foreground_service.purpose: Keep assigned-job updates and fresh driver location available while driver switches to navigation or locks the screen
foreground_service.visible_control: Ongoing shift notification opens driver screen; offline/sign-out stops service
foreground_service.restart: No boot receiver; no automatic restart after process termination

owner_decisions_required: Whether each transfer qualifies as collection/sharing under current Play definitions
Target age groups and content-rating answers
Actual provider contracts and production configuration
